name: gated-development-orchestration
description: Coordinate human-verifiable checkpoint development through role-scoped rounds, human actor takeover, bounded root-cause correction, evidence reuse, and independent review.

interface.longDescription: GDO 4.2 keeps the v3 lifecycle and GDO 4.1 human actor model while adding bounded defect aggregation, correction completeness, and explicit later-round evidence economy so fresh Evidence rounds do not mechanically reset the campaign.
defaultPrompt: Load the GDO workflow core and only the active role skill.
Perform the authorized GDO round using current GitHub authority and current actor authority.
Preserve v3 lifecycle markers, bounded correction scope, retained valid proof, actor-takeover semantics, and sole Independent Review PASS authority.
